thread:
emily: Postmortem follow-up: recurring latency bursts on /generate during traffic surges. We agreed on three remediation tracks: batching/cache changes, temporary SLO cohort, and dashboard/alerts. Need owners and dates.

rajesh: I'll own batching + long-seq queueing. Plan: separate queue for seq>1200, cap batch size for that queue, and add sampling logs for tail latency. PR incoming. ETA: Wed EOD.

sam: I'll take dashboard and alerting. Current 95/99 combined alert is noisy. Will add a 99p page rule + error-budget burn panel (30m burn rate). Will test in staging Thursday.

ops-bot: Canary started: opt-batcher v3 -> canary (10%) at 2026-03-25T02:04:10Z (sha: d4e5f6).

zoe: I'll draft the SLO cohort RFC: 7-day, model=X-large only, rollback if 99p > 1.2s for 2h. Will include communication checklist for PM/CS. ETA: Fri morning.

emily: Good. Please keep it cohort-scoped, not global. Also include a post-change verification runbook (how to read the burn panel and when to rollback).

rajesh: Note on timeline: after PR merge, run 24h canary at 10% then if stable ramp to 50% for 24h. Canary metrics: 99p latency, queue wait, CPU.

sam: Alert rule draft (staging):
```
alert: High99LatencyByModel
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) > 1.1
for: 15m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Will add runbook link to alert text.

zoe: RFC draft: https://docs.internal/slo/6889-cohort-temp-adjust.md. Includes cohort selector and notification templates.

emily: Ownership summary: batching/queue = rajesh; alerts/dashboard = sam; SLO cohort & comms = zoe; I'll track in the incident board and own cross-team notifications.

rajesh: Added I-6899 with milestones and canary schedule.

sam: Posted staging dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/efgh5678/latency-burn (staging).

emily: Weekly ops sync next Mon 10:00 to review error-budget trajectory and canary. Tag any follow-on pages with "latency-burst" so we can aggregate. :white_check_mark:

zoe: Will monitor and post a 48h status update.

emily: Thanks all. Short updates here only.
